executive_summary: Trading Company is a monorepo paper-trading platform with a Node.js/Express backend (port 11110), a TypeScript trading engine with matching engine and double-entry ledger (port 3001), and a Next.js terminal frontend. The architecture follows a clean separation: shared types in packages/shared, business logic in engine, price feed caching in backend, and UI in terminal. Core features (order matching, ledger, price feeds, WebSocket streaming, iPaymu payments) are implemented; production readiness gaps exist in database scalability (SQLite-only), Redis caching, test coverage imbalance (backend has 1 test vs engine's 26), and missing controllers layer.
